crossRefs.note: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among…
to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains…
